events.summary: !Kath joins Hurkyl, Drafna, Feldon and Chayum-Icha in meetings with the Archimandrite to establish the Union of the Third Path.
events.quote: to establish the Union of the Third Path

events.summary: People of all cultures flock to Terisia City to join the Union and escape the chaos.
events.quote: people of all cultures flocked to Terisia City to join the teams of mages and scholars

events.summary: After the Fall of Terisia City the Third Path survives in small pockets that join the Conclave of Mages.
events.quote: the Third Path lived on in smaller pockets of magic users that eventually joined the hidden citadel of the Conclave of Mages

relations.quote: !Kath of the Malpiri clan was one of the founders of the Third Path
